analysis:
Reviewed three provider-swift changes: GlobalKVCacheBudget.proactiveReclaimSweep (head lines 384-387), IdleCalibrationCoordinator (cancelledBy tracking, hasSession, cancellationSource, head lines 10-64), and ModelCalibrationPolicy (shape-warmup constants, env-var mode parsing, new Cell.sampled flag, new ModelCalibrationState fields). No security regression found.

GlobalKVCacheBudget: the sweep is now skipped while an idle calibration or shape-warmup session exists. This only defers an opportunistic MLX cache trim (the proactive sweep) to the next tick. It does not affect reservations, ledger charges, admission or the cap. The reactive path (recordReservationRefusal → scheduleReclaim, line 317) is unchanged, so admission under pressure still reclaims. The residual availability risk (T-029-like) is that a long-lived session defers cache returns. Sessions are bounded by the 20s warmup budget and are preempted by foreground requests, so this is minor.

IdleCalibrationCoordinator: additions are diagnostic state guarded by the same lock; no new lock-ordering or reentrancy issues. cancelledBy is reset on each new session. hasSession is a lock-protected read, and the sweep path reads it without nesting locks.

ModelCalibrationPolicy: the patch is only partially visible. DARKBLOOM_TTFT_SHAPE_WARMUP is a local operator-controlled env var, within the TB-003 operator trust model, and affects only synthetic warmup workloads. The sampled flag implies synthetic default sampling cells; the cell contents are fixed tokens, not consumer data (A-001). No wire, attestation, key, or cache-storage changes, so T-041 is untouched.

Remaining questions for integration (not findings): the code that consumes the new warmup cells and state (engine/ProviderLoop warmup runner) is outside the supplied units. It needs checking that synthetic warmup requests do not populate the SSD prefix cache with donations (T-041 scope), do not log prompt content, and release their service-budget and memory charges on cancellation. The 'settle' wait on the self-test's service charge should also be bounded. These were not verifiable from the supplied evidence.
